facts.fact: Statutory Instrument No. 4 of 2025, made by the Minister for State President on 13 January 2025, provides that the Data Protection Act, 2024 (Act No. 18 of 2024) comes into operation on 14 January 2025.

note: The order is a bare commencement instrument: it states nothing on an authority, substantive regulations or application, and is not recorded as aspect 3.
